summary: cleanup: odzyskiwanie miejsca - snap revizje, journal, cache, JetBrains, libvirt, gitive-isolated

delivery.outcome: fixos cleanup gains disk-space reclaim actions: --snap-old removes disabled snap revisions, --journal vacuums systemd journal, --user-cache selects oversized ~/.cache entries, --jetbrains removes stale Toolbox channels and IDE caches, --libvirt removes VM images not attached to any defined domain, --gitive removes stale gitive-isolated workspaces, --docker-buildcache prunes every buildx builder cache (including docker-container drivers not covered by --docker-all) plus dangling images; all are listed in the interactive command menu
nonGoals: No removal of user documents — ~/Videos, ~/Downloads and similar are never scanned for deletion
No deletion of running/attached VM volumes, active snap revisions, or gitive workspaces bound to a container
No unattended removal without explicit selection or --yes

architecture.decision: New fixos/cli/_cleanup_space.py module holds six scan/select/confirm handlers reusing _cleanup_utils helpers; cleanup_cmd.py gains one flag per target routed through the existing single-action dispatch; main.py lists the new commands
interfaceChanges: fixos cleanup gains --snap-old, --journal, --user-cache, --jetbrains, --libvirt, --gitive, --docker-buildcache options (plus matching -c names)
architecture.rollback: Revert the touched source files and ticket metadata
